Current sources: BT4012_Proposal_BAF_Revised.pdf and feedback.md.
The BAF proposal covers training recency, class imbalance, model choice and
chronological evaluation. Feedback asks for recent K versus historical K
comparisons to separate size from recency, and model-specific feature justification.
BAF Base (Kaggle version 2) is downloaded locally at data/raw/baf/Base.csv,
with checksums and a provenance manifest; 1M rows, 32 columns, months 0-7.
The first study uses Base under docs/experiment-protocol.md and configs/study.json.
Modules under baf/ implement development-only EDA and controlled experiments.
OpenSpec tasks and reports/baf-study-v1/ track verified completion and findings.
The first study completed 107 fits; month 7 is an already-consumed holdout.

docs/improvement-protocol.md: 54 development fits (including 3 adaptive
logistic diagnostic fits), 9 validation blends, 5 exploratory month-7 fits
and 2 selected blends. See reports/baf-improvements-v1/findings.md for
measured gains, multi-metric policies, ablations and conditional uncertainty.

frozen studies. The performance goal remains unachieved and further tuning
needs a new study; month 7 remains consumed.

0.327802. All 27 predictions, 99 contrasts, 35,532 query rows and 18 group
summaries were checked; four miniature integration fits are counted separately.

all-negative groups. Raw finite scores are not probabilities. Two exploratory

goal remains unachieved; further tuning needs a new study and month 7 is consumed.

Archived planning documents are historical context, not current decisions.
Prefer chronological evaluation on identical future applications. Fit preprocessing
on training data only; tune using validation and freeze choices before final testing.
Keep raw data out of git and provide reproducible README commands with modelling code.
The report is 8-12 pages excluding references/appendices; use Problem Description,
Data Overview, Methodology, Experiments and Results, Conclusion. Report and
presentation are due 2026-11-20 23:59 Asia/Singapore. Acknowledge AI and external code.
Main specs describe current requirements; change specs describe planned work.
